tools.name: inspect_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Call before spending on an unfamiliar x402 resource. Free, read-only, and never sends payment credentials.

tools.name: audit_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Purchase a deep, deterministic audit of payment schema, discovery metadata, redirects, CORS, cache, and operational signals. Returns HTTP 402 until the MCP client supplies a valid payment for this call.

tools.name: order_x402_remediation
tools.description: Purchase a durable remediation intake after a failed audit. Creates an order but never deploys, signs, or spends automatically.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "inspect_x402_endpoint" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
